subject.title: fix(qqbot): bound gateway websocket handshake waits at 30s

question: Should QQBot adopt an unconditional 30-second opening-handshake boundary, matching the bounded behavior used by sibling gateway transports?
rationale: The implementation is sound, but replacing an indefinite wait with fail-closed behavior intentionally changes outcomes for exceptionally slow existing proxy or network paths.

options.title: Adopt the 30-second bound
options.body: Accept the bounded availability tradeoff and merge after coordinating the same-factory rebase.

options.title: Choose another fixed budget
options.body: Select and document a QQBot-specific timeout if its gateway or supported proxy paths require different tolerance.

options.title: Defer fail-closed behavior
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers prefer the current unbounded compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Adopt the 30-second bound
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded availability tradeoff and merge after coordinating the same-factory rebase.

likelyOwner.reason: The major current QQBot gateway architecture and connection lifecycle work traces to this contributor.
